retry_torch_function_on_cuda_oom: wrap a pytorch function with retry_if_cuda_oom to automatically retry on CUDA out of memory errors
use_cuda_oom_context_manager: use the _ignore_torch_cuda_oom context manager to silently catch and ignore CUDA OOM RuntimeError exceptions
wrap_stateless_callable_for_oom_retry: wrap a stateless callable that takes tensor arguments to retry after clearing CUDA cache on OOM
fallback_to_cpu_on_cuda_oom: use retry_if_cuda_oom to automatically fall back to CPU execution when GPU memory is exhausted
review_cuda_oom_retry_decorator: review the retry_if_cuda_oom decorator that retries functions after CUDA OOM by emptying cache then falling back to CPU
